messages:
maya: Heads up: Sales pushed a req from BigBank for a longer onboard fallback path for the new Llama-X family. They want a 21-day grace window and automatic failback if quality regressions >2% on our evals. Need product + eng decision today.

sam: Can we do 21d? Our canary + bench pipeline currently uses 7d. Longer window increases resource lock and storage for pinned models.

emily: Customer is sensitive to hallucination regressions; they will only accept auto-fallback, not manual. Sales mentioned they won't sign without it. :grimacing: 

jonathan: Operationally auto-fallback needs guardrails. Suggest: detect metric violation for 3 consecutive days at cohort level, trigger staged fallback to previous pinned variant + notify.

maya: What about billing / credits during fallback? Sales expects credits for downtime >SLA.

sam: We can add a flag `suppress_billing=true` during automatic fallback but need legal OK. Also need limited number of fallbacks per tenant to prevent oscillation (rate limit).

emily: Propose customer opt-in checkbox during onboarding and a one-time rollback budget; also require a pinned previous model retained for 30 days post-rollout.

maya: :thumbsup: Ok can we sketch rollout config? Sam, can you paste config we can show Sales?

sam:
```yaml
rollout_policy:
  canary_percent: 10
  full_rollout_days: 14
  grace_period_days: 21
  auto_fallback:
    enabled: true
    trigger_window_days: 3
    metric: 'eval_quality.delta'
    threshold: -0.02
    fallback_target: 'previous_pinned'
    billing_credits: 'pro-rata after 24h'
```

jonathan: Couple notes: need a circuit breaker if fallback_target not compatible (e.g., tokenizer or model-arch mismatch). Also keep KV cache compatibility checks and preserve convo IDs in traces.

emily: Sales is also asking for an SLA term - can we commit to rollback time <2h after detection? Probably not; fallback staging takes time and can require capacity.

maya: Suggest two tiers: Standard (no auto-fallback, 7d grace) and Enterprise (auto-fallback, 21d + credits + legal SOW). That should align with sales asks.

sam: Agree. Enterprise requires keeping previous pinned model and quantization artifacts for 30d. We'll need storage estimate.

jonathan: Add alerting to Console + paging: page on-call if auto-fallback triggers for >1 tenant in 24h. Also log detailed diffs for postmortem.

emily: I'll update the SOW draft wording: "automatic fallback to previously pinned model if end-to-end eval quality degrades beyond agreed thresholds" and include rollback budget language.

maya: Next steps: Sam to open infra ticket with config + compat checks; Jonathan to list tracing/ops changes; Emily to modify SOW; I'll coordinate with Sales and Legal. Deadline EOD tomorrow.

sam: I'll open ticket INF-2486 and ping @eng-oncall. ETA EOD tomorrow.

jonathan: I'll sketch runbook and alerting matrix.
